summary: The island state made of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. England and Scotland united as Great Britain in 1707, Ireland joined in 1801 and most of it left in 1922. It was the centre of the largest empire in history.

events.note: Dated from the union of England and Scotland as Great Britain on 1 May 1707. The kingdoms of England and Scotland have entries of their own.

events.label: United Kingdom
events.note: Union with Ireland created the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.

events.label: Present borders
events.note: Most of Ireland left as the Irish Free State.
